page_title: NAN 0-0 HAV | Nantes v Le Havre 26/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+9' Arthur Desmas (Le Havre) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
90+5' Arouna Sangante (Le Havre) has tested the patience of referee Miguel Nogueira and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90+3' Florent Mollet (Nantes) pounces on a great cross inside the box, but lashes his powerful first-time shot inches over the bar.
90+3' Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Alban Lafont scrambling, but it flies just over the bar.
90+1' Florent Mollet (Nantes) collects a pass on the edge of the box but he slips the ball just wide of the right post.
90' 8 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Florent Mollet (Nantes) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
90' Eray Comert (Nantes) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
88' Jaouen Hadjam (Nantes) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
85' Miguel Nogueira shows a yellow card to Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) for his blatant foul.
84' Florent Mollet (Nantes) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save.
84' Jaouen Hadjam (Nantes) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
81' The corner is swung in but Le Havre can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
80' The referee allows time for a substitution. Gautier Lloris will be replaced by Yoann Salmier (Le Havre).
78' Samuel Moutoussamy (Nantes) collects a rebound and produces a mid-range attempt. The ball goes to the bottom right corner, but Arthur Desmas keeps it out with an amazing save.
77' Pierre Aristouy has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jaouen Hadjam (Nantes) replacing Ronael Pierre-Gabriel.
77' It's time for a substitution. Samuel Moutoussamy (Nantes) comes on in place of Moussa Sissoko.
76' Le Havre can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
74' Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
71' Luka Elsner has decided to substitute Nabil Alioui and he is replaced by Yassine Kechta (Le Havre).
70' The referee signals a substitution. Florent Mollet (Nantes) is brought on as a substitute for Douglas Augusto.
67' Andre Ayew (Le Havre) takes out his opponent with a terrible tackle and is sent off by the referee!
66' Daler Kuzyaev (Le Havre) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
66' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Nabil Alioui (Le Havre).
65' The substitution has been made. Andre Ayew (Le Havre) has replaced Loic Nego.
65' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre) comes onto the pitch for Antoine Joujou.
64' Jean-Kevin Duverne (Nantes) makes a slide tackle, but referee Miguel Nogueira blows for a foul.
59' Pierre Aristouy has decided to make a change. Matthis Abline (Nantes) replaces Mostafa Mohamed.
59' Ignatius Ganago (Nantes) is being substituted because of an injury. Pierre Aristouy sends Adson on the pitch.
58' Ignatius Ganago (Nantes) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
57' Ignatius Ganago (Nantes) has a goal ruled out for offside!
56' An attempted cross from Moses Simon (Nantes) is cleared.
55' The corner from Nabil Alioui (Le Havre) is hurriedly cleared.

55' Daler Kuzyaev (Le Havre) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. The ball goes out of play. Le Havre are awarded a corner kick.
52' Douglas Augusto (Nantes) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
51' Nantes work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
46' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Andy Logbo trots off the pitch and is replaced by Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' Miguel Nogueira has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' Ronael Pierre-Gabriel (Nantes) takes out his opponent with a horrible challenge and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
45' The resulting set piece from Nantes is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
41' Nabil Alioui (Le Havre) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
40' Nantes take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
40' A lofted cross from Moses Simon (Nantes) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
37' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Nantes comes to nothing.
36' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Nantes.
32' Nantes have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

31' Ronael Pierre-Gabriel (Nantes) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Nantes.
29' Jean-Kevin Duverne (Nantes) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
29' Gautier Lloris (Le Havre) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Miguel Nogueira no option but to blow his whistle.
26' Eray Comert (Nantes) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Miguel Nogueira signals.
23' Nantes failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
23' Ronael Pierre-Gabriel (Nantes) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
21' The referee signals a free kick from long distance for Nantes.
16' Moses Simon (Nantes) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
16' Jean-Kevin Duverne (Nantes) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent.
15' Jean-Kevin Duverne (Nantes) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
15' Miguel Nogueira blows his whistle. Loic Nego (Le Havre) commits a foul after dangerous play.
9' Moses Simon (Nantes) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
6' The referee blows his whistle, Nantes are awarded a corner kick.
2' Nantes seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
2' Miguel Nogueira interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Christopher Operi (Le Havre).
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Nantes will take the kick-off.
Miguel Nogueira got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
